_note: woo-requests-gather-documents-from-sources design D-4. A document added through Gather documents on a Woo case records where it was found, so the decision can account for the search. A copied file carries `provenance` on its own informatieobject. A document linked from another case carries it on THIS case's zaakinformatieobject join instead, because the record also belongs to the other case and must not be rewritten by a search on this one. A fragment rather than an edit to 70-document-zaakdossier.json, per ADR-037, because several dossiq lanes build against the document schemas at once.

provenance.title: Where it was found
provenance.description: Where this document was found when it was gathered for a Woo request: the source, its location, the search terms, when the search ran and who ran it. Written once, when the document is added through Gather documents.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source it came from: files, cases or microsoft365.

location.description: Where it sat in that source: a folder path, a site and folder, a mailbox, or the other case.

searchedBy.title: Searched by
searchedBy.description: The user who ran the search and added the document.

custodian.description: The plan custodian whose files this document came from.
